mostWorthwhile.text: Trapping inhaled material was the most worthwhile step because the result showed both what mucus catches and what can continue toward the air sacs.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the moving airway lining to the body felt less clear as a separate step: I expected to add the macrophages directly, and compatibility feedback revealed the required connection.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the lining had to be connected to the body before the macrophages could be added.

arbitrary.text: That required order felt somewhat arbitrary from the item descriptions, although the resulting body cutaway made the locations of the two defenses clearer.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: following the particles through successive defenses was easy to picture from the descriptions and made me curious about how the body responds to microbes that get through.
